root_cause.text: The function `cxl_payload_from_user_allowed()` in `drivers/cxl/core/mbox.c` casts the user-supplied payload pointer to a struct pointer (e.g., `struct cxl_mbox_set_partition_info` or `uuid_t`) and dereferences it without first verifying that the payload size is at least as large as the expected struct, allowing an out-of-bounds read when a smaller payload is provided.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and KASAN backtrace show `uuid_equal` (via `memcmp`) reading 8 bytes past the allocated buffer when a 1-byte payload is sent for `CXL_MBOX_OP_CLEAR_LOG`. The patch adds explicit size checks: `if (in_size < sizeof(*pi))` and `if (in_size < sizeof(uuid_t))` before accessing the payload content.
